_comment: CCM-merge x RPBE frozen method (plan v2 P0-3): machine-readable freeze of the method decisions. The trainer must read values from here (no silent defaults) and refuse inconsistent CLI overrides. Sources: Ky-Fan ridge/m from the completed 5-seed TGN experiment; lambda_kf from the r_eff~0.1 calibration rule (plan L5), produced by the calibration-only run and committed HERE before the five seeds run.
frozen_source: five-seed TGN experiment on Wikipedia (exact_replay, ridge=1e-3, m=64, lambda calibrated to r_eff~0.1 = 0.088)

adapter.lora_r_note: LoRA rank for the trainable adapter (train_ccm historical default; L1 official reproduction skipped by user decision, r=8 fixed for the formal runs)

lambda_calibration.rule: r_eff = lambda * ||g_KF|| / ||g_task|| ~ 0.1, measured on theta_0 (calibration-only run, before ANY optimizer/scheduler step), calibrated once on the initial full window (training-only), then frozen for all seeds
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: R8 r_eff=0.3 scan arm (2026-09-08, user ruling): lambda = 0.3 / r_eff(lambda=1)=4.485 -> 0.06689 (0.0669). Main arm lambda 0.02230 (r_eff~0.1) stored in .bak_r8_lambda backup. Seed1 ours run.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter (TGN identity is its special case)
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: Review round 8 (2026-09-07): the single 64-dim sketch is replaced by FOUR independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r; never concatenated into one 128-dim covariance). Depth bucket b(L_v) modulates the future signature phi_r(h,b(L)) = phi_h + b_L^(r) with fixed per-branch per-depth +/-1 signatures.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch: C_ZZ'=(1-a_Z)C_ZZ+a_Z I, C_PP'=(1-a_P)C_PP+a_P I, C_ZP'=sqrt((1-a_Z)(1-a_P)) C_ZP; a_Z,a_P from the OAS rule (Chen et al. 2010) estimated on the current window, stop-gradient. The fixed ridge keeps only its numerical-safety role.

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init (Review round 7 / user ruling 2026-09-07): R = U tanh(V [prev;cur;time(t)]) with U.weight exactly 0 and V small random (init_scale). Step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero AND every U/V parameter receives gradient from the first step. The old scalar gate s (s=0 init) is REMOVED — it left U/V with zero gradient at step 0.
gamma.init_note: See src/rpbe/hosts/ccm/gamma_residual.py class docstring; code aligned 2026-09-07 11:36, spec synced 2026-09-07.

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4), not a mechanical microbatch count
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the three arms

training.steps_note: 300 GLOBAL/window steps for the round-7 official-host arms (user ruling 2026-09-07): task-only-cont / ours-cont from the official merge-adapter start, lr 3e-5, checkpoint every 50. Prior: 500 (e50 curve); previous 1000 (per-paper claim).
training.grad_clip_source: official HF Trainer default (max_grad_norm); train_ccm must refuse an inconsistent override
training.merge_cadence_note: window-matched: all three arms fire an update on the same adaptive boundary (>= min_effective_cuts dialogues with k>=4); the fixed grad_accum cadence exists only for the ccm_merge_official reproduction arm, whose arm name marks it as outside the main result
training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (training only; inference is a single forward)
training.eval: matched-cohort depth curves on the clean test split; primary metric = per-token NLL difference
training.schedule_note: Keep the ORIGINAL 1000-step warmup/cosine LR schedule (warmup=30, cosine over 1000) while the e50 pilot stops at 500 — review ruling 2026-09-05: a 500-step schedule would NOT be the first half of the 1000-step run.

sampling.rule: depth-stratified legal cuts: q_L ~ 1/sqrt(n_L) with 3x-uniform oversampling cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id, not the stream cursor); turn-14/L=13 uses only long-enough dialogues with the target FIXED at the 15th turn and a 13-turn compressed history; L=1 dialogues carry task CE only (v = k - 3 >= 1 requires L >= 2).
sampling.paired_report: scripts/eval_ccm_paired.py: paired d_i = NLL_task,i - NLL_ours,i; BCa bootstrap (20k), Huber location, paired randomization test, LOO stability, single-dialogue share <= 20%, branch direction agreement >= 3/4.
